## Claims
- [source-backed] The later-paper candidate is Avery St. Dizier–Alexander Yong, *Presenting the cohomology of a Schubert variety: Proof of the minimality conjecture*, DOI \(10.1112/jlms.12832\); its abstract states that it proves the minimality conjecture using the Hopf-algebra structure of symmetric functions. [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832]
- [source-backed] The supplied exact text defines the earlier paper’s \(J_v\) by \(J_v:=\Bbbk\text{-span}\{\sigma_u:u\ge v\}\). [source-2, lines 328-337]
- [source-backed] The earlier paper introduces \(\Bbbk\) as a field of characteristic zero in its Borel-presentation setup. [source-2, lines 125-139]
- [unsupported] No indexed full-text passage from the later paper is supplied; therefore its exact definitions, theorem number(s), coefficient ring, and the precise map relating its \(J_v\) to \(\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\) cannot be recorded.
- [unsupported] The DOI abstract alone does not establish an integral Schur-span description of \(J_v\), an integral box-algebra identification, or hypotheses under which such an identification holds.

## Strategy
Treat the DOI record only as metadata/abstract evidence. Separate the earlier paper’s displayed definition from any claimed later-paper refinement.

## Gaps
The requested theorem-level later-paper text is absent. In particular unresolved are: theorem locator; definition of \(J_v\); coefficient ring; definition of the box algebra; and the exact comparison map and its direction.
